verdict.rationale: Close is a CRM with a built-in AI agent (Chloe), so letting users connect external MCP servers for that agent to use is a fair question. However, the evidence only documents Close running its own MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. That is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing shows Chloe or any other part of Close connecting to third-party MCP servers.
